sourceRoutes.findings: Publisher announcement dated 2023-09-27 names Vearn among TGS game reveals. Story coverage alone cannot imply absence of a Temple of Recollection bonus boss. Public pages provide no character package. Individual Steam announcement web open was non-retryable URL-safety rejection; not retried via shell/alternate endpoint. All-news page independently read successfully before that rejection.

sourceRoutes.author: Poppu, Dragon Quest Fan administrator
sourceRoutes.findings: Guide explains Vearn as Temple of Recollection boss. Downloaded and visually inspected screenshot: old man with wrinkles, long white hair/beard, horned crown, blue robe and staff. Confirms elderly Vearn presentation, not young true-body mesh. Screenshot is evidence only, not reusable model texture.

sourceRoutes.author: Sal Romano
sourceRoutes.findings: Reports official TGS announcement placing Vearn in deepest Temple of Recollection. Public image URL returned actual HTTP403; stopped with no alternate image size/host attempt. No game/stream downloaded.

Old and True Dark King Vearn appear as data pages, JavaScript stats and PNG portraits. No model, native skeleton/motion, VFX or audio candidate in this tree. Fifteen .clip files are named under images backgrounds/attack icons; they were not downloaded or parsed and are not counted as animation clips. Source directory/file names alone do not prove native 3D game data.
